publisher_name: Le Matricule des Anges (SIRET 389 730 847 00057; directeur de la publication Thierry Guichard)
independence_evidence: Legal notice gives the publisher as Le Matricule des Anges itself, head office BP 20225, 34004 Montpellier cedex 1, SIRET 389 730 847 00057, publication director Thierry Guichard; a stand-alone literary monthly since 1992 with no media-group owner.
qualifies_reason: Independent Montpellier literary monthly whose issue 278 (November 2026) is the current issue on its own site.
what_it_is: A French-language monthly devoted to contemporary literature, built around a themed dossier on a writer or movement plus review sections for fiction, poetry, essays, theatre, literary history and illustrated books. It runs ten issues a year, sells single copies and subscriptions directly and gives subscribers access to its online archive back to 1992. It suits French readers who follow small-press and translated literature closely.

Frequency recorded as monthly for a stated 10 issues per year (the subscription is '10 numéros' and the site calls it 'le mensuel de la littérature contemporaine').
